params.message:
One list of relations, on Bespreken; Netwerk is the graph

The Contacten tab on Netwerk and step 1 of Bespreken were the same
relations twice: the same columns (importance, who carries it), the same
panel, a different order.

Step 1 of Bespreken, now called Relaties, is the whole list
(Office\RelationList): the agenda's relations first, in its order and
with its reason, then the rest by number of projects, 30 at first and 25
more at a time. Search, role, group and carrier filter it, Relatie
toevoegen sits above it, each row shows whether it was discussed, and a
row opens its context panel in place. Saving the open relation opens the
next one still to do.

Netwerk keeps only the graph with its filters and panels. An old link to
the Contacten tab opens Bespreken, or the graph's panel when it names a
relation. The plan in docs/verkennen-en-overdragen.md records where this
departs from it.
